dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: Provides many deep, non‑obvious AWS Backup specifics (cold‑storage vs deletion timing, governance vs compliance lock nuances, AWS‑managed key sharing, cross‑region copy lock independence, WindowsVSS requirement, cron syntax details, PITR vs snapshots, tag‑selection eventual consistency, legal hold overrides, update‑behavior clearing fields, cross‑account KMS grants). A capable model would not automatically know all these.

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: Defines a clear AWS‑specific mindset and ordered classification steps, includes concrete CLI pagination and confirmation‑gate procedures, and maps remediation to exact AWS commands. Only minor generic phrasing (e.g., "validate input structure") prevents a perfect score.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: Comprehensive NEVER list with concrete reasoning for each pitfall (empty selections, governance lock, impossible lifecycle, AWS‑managed key, sub‑daily schedule, cross‑region copy lock assumptions, vault‑lock enablement without retention check, tag‑selection coverage, etc.).

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Complete front‑matter, clear description, explicit when‑to‑use, activation triggers, invocation schema, and verdict shape. An agent can reliably know when to invoke the skill.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: Top‑level quick reference table, then deeper sections (mindset, pre‑flight, step‑by‑step, edge cases, anti‑patterns, safety, remediation). Some critical rules (e.g., cold‑storage rule) are buried in Step 0, causing slight cognitive load.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Destructive actions (plan updates, vault lock) are gated by mandatory confirmation and safety checks; classification is free‑form. Calibration matches task fragility perfectly.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: Follows a coherent, recognizable structure (mindset → quick reference → pre‑flight → process → output → examples → anti‑patterns → safety → remediation).

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: Provides decision tree, deterministic output format, concrete CLI remediation, pagination guidance, and works correctly in the model output examples. Slight omission of detailed schedule‑parsing edge cases prevents a perfect score.
